condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: The affected profile cannot provide service access; UE/user access suspension is supported.

conditions: MCX Service Administrator or authorized MCX User
claims.conclusion: Support remote temporary disable and re-enabling of temporarily disabled UEs; re-enable transport is unspecified here. Limited access follows organization policy.

conditions: Permanent disable by administrator or authorized user
claims.conclusion: Remove all UE-stored MCX Service User Profiles; no MCX service access.

limitations: No command encoding, recovery procedure for permanent disable, or physical erasure guarantee.
